"""Single-episode, camera-guided robot controller. All executed targets are logged.
Use: python gen.py observe NAME; python gen.py move X Y Z FINGER [SECONDS]
     python gen.py orient X Y Z FINGER SECONDS RX RY RZ
Rotations are xyz Euler angles in degrees. Replay uses recorded absolute targets.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from kin import fk
OUT=Path('/app/output');r=Robot()
LIMIT=np.array(r.spec()['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
FRONT=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[1,0,0]],float)
def observe(name='obs'):
 res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none');res.save(str(OUT/name));return res

def ik(pos,rot,q):
 def err(v):
  t=fk(v,.093)
  return np.r_[(t[:3,3]-pos)*5,R.from_matrix(rot@t[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec(),(v-q)*.008]
 sol=least_squares(err,q,bounds=(LIMIT[:,0]+.001,LIMIT[:,1]-.001),max_nfev=200)
 t=fk(sol.x,.093)
 if np.linalg.norm(t[:3,3]-pos)>.012:raise ValueError(f'Unreachable {pos}: {t[:3,3]}')
 return sol.x

def execute(a,name):
 a=np.array(a);log={'name':name,'actions':a.tolist(),'dt':.1}
 with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(log)+'\n')
 res=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=.1,cameras=['left','right','wrist'],video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
 res.save(str(OUT/'latest'));print(json.dumps(res.meta));return res

def move(pos,f=.04,seconds=3.,rot=None):
 res=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none');p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']);q=p[:7];start=fk(q,.093);rot=start[:3,:3] if rot is None else rot
 n=int(round(seconds/.1));a=[]
 from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp
 sr=Slerp([0,1],R.from_matrix([start[:3,:3],rot]))
 for t in np.linspace(0,1,n):
  s=t*t*(3-2*t);q=ik(start[:3,3]*(1-s)+np.array(pos)*s,sr(s).as_matrix(),q);a.append(np.r_[q,f,f])
 a.extend([a[-1]]*10)
 return execute(a,f'move {pos} fingers {f}')
if __name__=='__main__':
 cmd=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'observe'
 if cmd=='observe':res=observe(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'latest');print(res.meta)
 elif cmd in ['move','front','orient']:
  vals=list(map(float,sys.argv[2:]));pos=vals[:3];f=vals[3] if len(vals)>3 else .04;secs=vals[4] if len(vals)>4 else 3
  rot=FRONT if cmd=='front' else R.from_euler('xyz',vals[5:8],degrees=True).as_matrix() if cmd=='orient' else None
  move(pos,f,secs,rot)
 elif cmd=='grip':
  p=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'];execute([np.r_[p[:7],float(sys.argv[2]),float(sys.argv[2])]]*20,'grip')
 elif cmd=='replay':
  for line in (OUT/'actions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
   v=json.loads(line);res=r.submit('joint_position',v['actions'],dt=v['dt'],cameras=[],video='none')
   if res.done:break
